content.equation:
Initial Dose:
When Route is Oral or IV and Output Units is mg; mg/hr:
Initial Dose (min) = Weight * 600
• Initial Dose (min) is calculated in mg
• Weight is input in kg
Initial Dose (max) = Weight * 700
• Initial Dose (max) is calculated in mg
• Weight is input in kg
When Route is Oral and Output Units is mL; mL/hr:
Initial Dose (min) = Weight * 0.78
• Initial Dose (min) is calculated in mL of a 98% solution
• Weight is input in kg
Initial Dose (max) = Weight * 0.9
• Initial Dose (max) is calculated in mL of a 98% solution
• Weight is input in kg
When Route is IV and Output Units is mL; mL/hr:
Initial Dose (min) = Weight * 7.6
• Initial Dose (min) is calculated in mL of a 10% solution
• Weight is input in kg
Initial Dose (max) = Weight * 8.9
• Initial Dose (max) is calculated in mL of a 10% solution
• Weight is input in kg
Maintenance Dose:
When Route is Oral or IV and Output Units is mg; mg/hr:
Maintenance Dose (MD) = Weight * Dose
• Maintenance Dose (MD) is calculated in mg/hr
• Weight is input in kg
• Dose is input in mg/kg/hr and is dependent on hemodialysis status and alcohol status:
o When Hemodialysis is Yes and
• Chronic Drinker is Yes, Dose = 257
• Chronic Drinker is No, Dose = 169
o When Hemodialysis is No and
• Chronic Drinker is Yes, Dose = 154
• Chronic Drinker is No, Dose = 66
When Route is Oral and Output Units is mL; mL/hr:
Maintenance Dose (MD) = Weight * Dose
• Maintenance Dose (MD) is calculated in mL/hr of a 98% solution
• Weight is input in kg
• Dose is input in mL/kg/hr of a 98% solution and is dependent on hemodialysis status and alcohol status:
o When Hemodialysis is Yes and
• Chronic Drinker is Yes, Dose = 0.33
• Chronic Drinker is No, Dose = 0.22
o When Hemodialysis is No and
• Chronic Drinker is Yes, Dose = 0.20
• Chronic Drinker is No, Dose = 0.09
When Route is IV and Output Units is mL; mL/hr:
Maintenance Dose (MD) = Weight * Dose
• Maintenance Dose (MD) is calculated in mL/hr of a 10% solution
• Weight is input in kg
• Dose is input in mL/kg/hr of a 10% solution and is dependent on hemodialysis status and alcohol status:
o When Hemodialysis is Yes and
• Chronic Drinker is Yes, Dose = 3.26
• Chronic Drinker is No, Dose = 2.13
o When Hemodialysis is No and
• Chronic Drinker is Yes, Dose = 1.96
• Chronic Drinker is No, Dose = 0.83
conditional_notes: Note: Oral dose based on a 98% solution; further dilution to ≤ 20% is required.
Note: Infusion rate based on a 10% solution.
